attributes.action: Support Life, Not Abortion — Stop Belfast City Hall Being Lit Up for Abortion
attributes.additional_details: I believe society should value and protect every human life, including children before birth. Public institutions should represent everyone, not promote one side of a deeply held moral issue. Belfast City Hall should not be illuminated to celebrate or promote abortion. I call on Parliament to respect pro-life voices, protect unborn children, and ensure public buildings remain neutral. Every child deserves a chance at life, and every mother deserves compassion, support and a genuine choice.
attributes.background: Every human life has value and deserves protection, including unborn life. A baby is a baby from the earliest stages of development, not simply “a few cells”. I want Parliament to protect unborn life and stop public buildings or resources being used to promote or celebrate abortion. Stand for life!

rejection.details: The responsibility for this lies with Belfast City Council, not Parliament or the UK Government.
